fusions.name: Split Tine
fusions.desc: Flings a tine that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then splits off to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage.

fusions.name: Two Ways at Once
fusions.desc: Looses 2 tines at once, spread wide apart, each dealing 13 damage and knocking its target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Crossed Prongs
fusions.desc: Crosses the tines before you, raising your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 8% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Branch
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
